mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(t1.sanghw_ymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS sanghwYmd , t1.jm_cd AS jmCd , t3.cj_nm AS jmNm , t1.fund_cd AS fundCd , t2.fund_nm AS fundNm , '채권' AS jmGu , 'C' AS jmGr , t1.aekm / 10000 AS aekm , t1.won_gm AS wonGm , NVL(t1.misu_ija, 0) + NVL(t1.sc_misu_ija, 0) AS misuIja , NVL(t1.sung_cost, 0) + NVL(t1.sc_sung_cost, 0) AS sungCost , NVL(t1.sunn_tax, 0) + NVL(t1.sc_sunn_tax, 0) + NVL(t1.yesu_tax, 0) + NVL(t1.sc_yesu_tax, 0) AS sunnTax , t1.won_ri_gm - (NVL(t1.sunn_tax, 0) + NVL(t1.sc_sunn_tax, 0) + NVL(t1.yesu_tax, 0) + NVL(t1.sc_yesu_tax, 0)) AS wonRiGm , t1.sunsu_ija AS holSunsuIja , t1.suib_ija AS holSuibIja , t1.currency AS currency FROM UCS0BH t1 JOIN SZM0IA t2 ON t2.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND t2.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd JOIN SCM0CJ t3 ON t3.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND t3.jm_cd = t1.jm_cd WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND t1.sanghw_ymd BETWEEN TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{fymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{tymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND t1.currency IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT TO_CHAR(t1.sanghw_ymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS sanghwYmd , t1.hj_cd AS jmCd , F_JM_NM(#{corpGr}, t1.hj_cd) AS jmNm , t1.fund_cd AS fundCd , t2.fund_nm AS fundNm , '현금' AS jmGu , 'H' AS jmGr , t1.aekm / 10000 AS aekm , t1.sanghw_aek AS wonGm , t1.misu_ija AS misuIja , t1.sung_cost AS sungCost , NVL(t1.sunn_tax, 0) + NVL(t1.yesu_tax, 0) AS sunnTax , NVL(t1.sanghw_aek, 0) + NVL(t1.misu_ija, 0) + NVL(t1.sung_cost, 0) - (NVL(t1.sunn_tax, 0) + NVL(t1.yesu_tax, 0)) AS wonRiGm , 0 AS holSunsuIja , 0 AS holSuibIja , NULL AS currency FROM UHM0HP t1 JOIN SZM0IA t2 ON t2.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND t2.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND t1.sanghw_ymd BETWEEN TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{fymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{tymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') ORDER BY sanghwYmd ASC, jmGu ASC, jmCd ASC, fundCd ASC

SELECT t1.CORP_GR AS corpGr , TO_CHAR(t1.sanghw_ymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS sanghwYmd , t1.fund_cd AS fundCd , ia.fund_nm AS fundNm , t1.jm_gr AS jmGr , DECODE(t1.jm_gr, 'C', '채권', 'H', '현금', t1.jm_gr) AS jmGu , t1.jm_cd AS jmCd , t1.sunhu_gb AS sunhuGb , F_JM_NM(t1.CORP_GR, t1.jm_cd) AS jmNm , t1.buy_date AS buyDate , t1.aekm AS aekm , t1.chui_aek AS chuiAek , t1.chui_aek AS wonGm , t1.misu_ija AS misuIja , t1.ija_tax AS ijaTax , t1.ija_tax AS sunnTax , t1.sury_aek AS suryAek , t1.sury_aek AS wonRiGm , t1.trustee AS trustee , t1.currency AS currency , t1.mod_user AS modUser , TO_CHAR(t1.mod_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS modDt FROM UZM0SH t1 JOIN SZM0IA ia ON ia.CORP_GR = t1.CORP_GR AND ia.fund_cd = t1.fund_cd WHERE t1.CORP_GR = #{corpGr} AND t1.sanghw_ymd BETWEEN TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{fymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{tymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') ORDER BY t1.fund_cd ASC, t1.jm_gr ASC, t1.jm_cd ASC, t1.sanghw_ymd ASC
